title: Design System: Financial Reset Planner — The Reset Ledger

poster.purpose: The primary monthly diagnosis on chartreuse.

shadows.name: setup-ambient
shadows.purpose: The borderless two-part setup workbook is the sole structurally elevated surface.

shadows.name: toast-ambient
shadows.purpose: Temporary local feedback above the ledger surface.

motion.name: ledger-arrival
motion.value: 360ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); clip-path inset(0 0 14% 0) → inset(0); saturate(.78) → saturate(1)
motion.purpose: User-triggered navigation and setup-step changes only; initial routing passes animation off.

motion.name: setup-progress
motion.purpose: Movement through the three setup questions.

motion.name: control-lift
motion.value: background-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease, transform 150ms ease; hover translateY(-2px)

motion.name: navigation-state
motion.value: color 150ms ease, background-color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease
motion.purpose: Immediate route hover and active feedback.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: animation: none; transition: none; scroll-behavior: auto
motion.purpose: Disables CSS motion; JavaScript also skips ledger arrival when reduced motion is requested.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The decisive ledger action: dark ink, chartreuse type, and a brief hover lift.

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A paper utility action with an ink border and chartreuse hover.

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: A subordinate destructive action with explicit danger color and a soft tomato hover.

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: A low-priority paper action whose soft rule strengthens only on hover.

components.name: Financial Input
components.description: A square-edged amount field whose prefix and input share one focusable wrapper.

narrative.overview:
The Reset Ledger makes financial triage feel like an authored household workbench rather than another pale software dashboard. Warm ledger paper, matte near-black ink, electric chartreuse, a single coral mark, and blue utility links create a practical world assembled from receipt stock, public-information posters, and marked-up monthly plans.

The hierarchy is intentionally blunt. Poster-scale diagnoses name the situation; a dark next-move block turns the answer into work; quieter ruled rows preserve the supporting trail. `styles.css` supplies the shared structure and print foundations, while `clarity.css` now carries this replacement visual world despite its legacy filename. Local Manrope and inline SVG are the only shipped visual assets; there are no raster images or external dependencies.
keyCharacteristics: Warm, visibly ruled paper instead of a blank application canvas.
Near-black navigation and work-order surfaces with chartreuse active states.
Poster-scale headlines paired with compact receipt labels and tabular figures.
Flat, square-edged panels organized by solid and dashed rules.
One coral mark for urgency or progress, with blue reserved for utility and focus.
A brief clip/filter reveal after user-triggered navigation or setup changes; no initial entrance effect.

rules.name: The One Highlighter Rule
rules.body: Chartreuse names the active decision; it must not become general decoration.

rules.name: The Meaning Before Color Rule
rules.body: Every financial state needs words or a number as well as color.

rules.name: The Comparable Figures Rule
rules.body: Use tabular numerals for balances, totals, allocations, progress amounts, and financial summaries.

rules.name: The Poster Then Receipt Rule
rules.body: Large type states the diagnosis once; supporting details step down sharply into compact labels and ruled rows.

rules.name: The Workbench Rule
rules.body: If a surface can be separated with a rule, spacing, or stock color, it does not get a shadow.

rules.name: The Cut-Paper Rule
rules.body: Do not introduce rounded SaaS cards, pills, glass panels, or decorative blobs. A pill shape is justified only by a genuinely circular marker or legacy semantic control.

dos: Do let one poster-scale diagnosis and one next move dominate the first viewport.
Do use chartreuse for the active decision, tomato for pressure or progress, and blue for links and focus.
Do preserve the ruled/grid canvas, hard rules, square utility controls, and receipt-like numerical trails.
Do keep unknown values visibly unknown and pair every semantic color with explicit language.
Do preserve local-only storage, responsive navigation, keyboard focus, reduced-motion behavior, and print output when extending the interface.
Do reuse local Manrope, inline SVG, and tabular numerals; no raster assets ship.
donts: Don't restore the pale Clarity dashboard, cobalt primary buttons, slate rail, or rounded white card system.
Don't soften ordinary content into floating cards, broad shadows, pills, gradients, glass, or generic dashboard chrome.
Don't scatter chartreuse or coral across low-priority content; their rarity gives the hierarchy force.
Don't animate the initial page load or add continuous decorative motion.
Don't hide secondary tools, destructive consequences, required financial labels, or missing-data states on small screens.
